content.title: Critique of Pure Reason (1781; English translation 1855)
content.author: Immanuel Kant · translated by J. M. D. Meiklejohn
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: Kant's criticism of the ontological, cosmological and design arguments (Transcendental Dialectic, Book II, chapter III). Kant was not an orthodox Christian; cited for his objections as he states them. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator named.
